```{r}
library(ggthemes)

label.util <- rep('Utility',6)
label.com <- rep('Community',6)
mult.factor.com <- c(1,5,10,20,30,40)

plotdf1 <- plotdf %>% filter(iteration == 4) %>% select(communities,cost.util,price.util,cost.total) %>% mutate(cost = cost.util) %>% mutate(price = price.util) %>% mutate(paradigm = label.util) %>% mutate(total.cost = cost.total) %>% select(communities,cost,price,paradigm,total.cost)

plotdf2 <- plotdf %>% filter(iteration == 4) %>% select(communities,cost.com,price.com,cost.total) %>% mutate(cost = cost.com*mult.factor.com) %>% mutate(price = price.com) %>% mutate(paradigm = label.com) %>% mutate(total.cost = cost.total) %>% select(communities,cost,price,paradigm,total.cost)

plotdf1
plotdf2

plotgraph <- rbind(plotdf1,plotdf2) %>%  arrange(paradigm) %>% mutate(pos.cost = c(11,10.5,11,10.5,10,9.5,2.5,2,2.5,2,2.5,2) )

plotgraph <- add_row(plotgraph, communities = '00', cost = as.numeric(plotdf[1,3]), price = as.numeric(plotdf[1,6]), paradigm = 'Utility', total.cost = as.numeric(plotdf[1,5]), pos.cost = 10   )  

# do not need to add community row for 0 vector
# plotgraph <- add_row(plotgraph, communities = '0', cost = cost.list.com.1[[1]], price = price.util[1], paradigm = 'Community', pos.cost = 5000000    )  

plotgraph
        

cost.plot <- plotgraph %>% select(communities,cost,price,paradigm,total.cost) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = communities, y = cost, fill = paradigm))+
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity')+
  
  
  
  #cost labels
  #geom_text(data = plotgraph, aes(x = communities, y = (pos.cost), label = paste0('$',cost) ), size = 4)+
  geom_text(data = plotgraph, aes(x = communities, y = 14.5, label = paste0('$',total.cost) ), size = 5,color = 'purple', fontface = 'bold.italic')+
  
  #price points and labels
  geom_point(aes(y = price*78.95, shape = paradigm), size = 4)+
  geom_text(data = plotgraph, aes(x = communities, y = price*78.95, label = paste0('$',format(round(price,3))) ), nudge_y = -1, size = 5)+
  
  
  ylim(0,15)+
  
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "")+
  scale_shape_discrete(name = "")+
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*(1/78.95), name = "Mean Electricity Price ($ / kWh)") )+
  xlab('Number of Communities Investing in DERs')+
  ylab('Total Costs ($ / Million)')+
  ggtitle('The Costs and Mean Prices of DER Invesment')+
  theme_economist()







cost.plot

plotgraph
```


```{r}
plotdf.prod

label.util <- rep('Utility',36)
label.com <- rep('Community',36)
label.ng <- rep('NG',36)
label.usolar <- rep('Solar.Utility',36)
label.uwind <- rep('Wind.Utility',36)
label.csolar <- rep('Solar.Community',36)
label.cwind <- rep('Wind.Community',36)
mult.factor.com <- c(1,5,10,20,30,40)

plotdf.prod.ng <- plotdf.prod %>% filter(iteration == 4) %>% select(communities,timeofday,production.ng.util) %>% mutate(production = production.ng.util) %>% mutate(paradigm = label.util) %>% mutate(source = label.ng ) %>% select(communities,timeofday,source,production,paradigm)

plotdf.prod.usolar <- plotdf.prod  %>% filter(iteration == 4) %>% select(communities,timeofday,production.solar.util) %>% mutate(production = production.solar.util) %>% mutate(paradigm = label.util) %>% mutate(source = label.usolar ) %>% select(communities,timeofday,source,production,paradigm)

plotdf.prod.uwind <- plotdf.prod  %>% filter(iteration == 4) %>% select(communities,timeofday,production.wind.util) %>% mutate(production = production.wind.util) %>% mutate(paradigm = label.util) %>% mutate(source = label.uwind ) %>% select(communities,timeofday,source,production,paradigm)

plotdf.prod.csolar <- plotdf.prod  %>% filter(iteration == 4) %>% select(communities,timeofday,production.solar.com) %>% mutate(production = production.solar.com) %>% mutate(paradigm = label.com) %>% mutate(source = label.csolar ) %>% select(communities,timeofday,source,production,paradigm)

plotdf.prod.cwind <- plotdf.prod  %>% filter(iteration == 4) %>% select(communities,timeofday,production.wind.com) %>% mutate(production = production.wind.com) %>% mutate(paradigm = label.com) %>% mutate(source = label.cwind ) %>% select(communities,timeofday,source,production,paradigm)

plotgraph.prod <- rbind(plotdf.prod.ng,plotdf.prod.usolar,plotdf.prod.uwind,plotdf.prod.csolar,plotdf.prod.cwind)

plotgraph.prod
  
plotgraph.prod.agg <- aggregate(plotgraph.prod, by = list(plotgraph.prod$communities,plotgraph.prod$source), FUN = mean)

#Fixing the mean aggregation and mutliplying by the number of communities
plotgraph.prod.agg$production <- plotgraph.prod.agg$production * c(rep(6,6),(6*c(1,5,10,20,30,40)),rep(6,6),(6*c(1,5,10,20,30,40)),rep(6,6))

plotgraph.prod.agg <- select(plotgraph.prod.agg, Group.1,Group.2,production)
plotgraph.prod.agg <- as_tibble(plotgraph.prod.agg)
plotgraph.prod.agg <- rename(plotgraph.prod.agg, Communities = Group.1, Source = Group.2, Production = production)

plotgraph.prod.agg

percents <- plotgraph.prod.agg[c(1:6),c(1,3)]
percents[2] <- round( (120-percents[2]) /120 * 100, 1)

plotgraph.prod.agg$percents <- rep( pull(percents,Production) ,5)

plotgraph.prod.agg <- add_row(plotgraph.prod.agg, Communities = '00', Source = 'NG', Production = 120  )  


plotgraph.prod.agg


```

```{r}



plotgraph.prod.agg


prod.plot <- plotgraph.prod.agg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Communities, y = Production, fill = Source))+
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity')+
  
  #production labels
  #geom_text(data = plotgraph.prod.agg, aes(x = Communities, y = (Production), label = Production ), size = 4)+
 
  #price points and labels
  geom_point(data = plotgraph.prod.agg, aes(x = Communities, y = percents*1.25), size = 4)+
  geom_text(data = plotgraph.prod.agg, aes(x = Communities, y = percents*1.25, label = paste0(percents,'%')), nudge_y = 10, size = 5) +
  # 
  # 
  ylim(0,125)+
  # 
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "")+
  scale_shape_discrete(name = "DER Generation (%)")+
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*(1/1.2), name = "Total Amount Generated by DERs (%)") )+
  xlab('Number of Communities Investing in DERs')+
  ylab('Total Production (GWh)')+
  ggtitle('Total Electricity Production by Source')+
  theme_economist()


prod.plot
```

```{r}
label.util <- rep('Utility',4)
label.com <- rep('Community',4)
mult.factor.com <- 30

plotdf1.itr <- plotdf %>% filter(communities == 30) %>% select(iteration,cost.util,price.util,cost.total) %>% mutate(cost = cost.util) %>% mutate(price = price.util) %>% mutate(paradigm = label.util) %>% mutate(total.cost = cost.total) %>% select(iteration,cost,price,paradigm,total.cost)

plotdf2.itr <- plotdf %>% filter(communities == 30) %>% select(iteration,cost.com,price.com,cost.total) %>% mutate(cost = cost.com*mult.factor.com) %>% mutate(price = price.com) %>% mutate(paradigm = label.com) %>% mutate(total.cost = cost.total) %>% select(iteration,cost,price,paradigm,total.cost)

plotgraph.itr <- rbind(plotdf1.itr,plotdf2.itr) %>%  arrange(paradigm) %>% mutate(pos.cost = c(6.0,6.5,7,7.5,2.5,3,3.5,4) )

cost.plot.itr <- plotgraph.itr %>% select(iteration,cost,paradigm) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = iteration, y = cost, fill = paradigm))+
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity')+
  geom_text(data = plotgraph.itr, aes(x = iteration, y = pos.cost, label = paste0('$',format(signif(cost, 3), big.mark=",")) ), size = 4)+
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Optimization Problem")+
  xlab('Number of Communities investing in DERs')+
  ylab('Total Costs ($ MM)')+
  ggtitle('Cost of Investing in DERs')+
  theme_fivethirtyeight()

price.plot.itr <- plotgraph.itr %>% select(iteration,price,paradigm) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = iteration, y = price))+
  geom_point(aes(color = paradigm), size = 3)+
  geom_text(data = plotgraph.itr, aes(x = iteration, y = price, label = paste0('$',format(round(price, 3))) ), nudge_x = 0.4)+
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Optimization Problem")+
  xlab('Number of Communities investing in DERs')+
  ylab('Mean Electricity Price ($/kWh)')+
  ggtitle('Prices for Providing Electricity')+
  theme_economist()


cost.plot.itr
price.plot.itr
plotgraph.itr
```
